When all three conditions are present, the resulting opportunity compounds across four vectors — volume growth, ASP expansion, operating leverage, and multiple re-rating — and can deliver 5–10x returns in compressed timeframes. [...] Wave 3 is where the heuristic should prove most actionable, because the bottlenecks are acute, durable, and the solvers are identifiable.
